CREATE VIEW [syn].[CHECK_NAME_SINGLE_CUSTOMER_BU_20240904] AS SELECT
ACID, Account_Number, Account_Name, Product_ID, Application, Checkbook_Name1, Checkbook_Name2, CIF, First_Name, Middle_Name, Last_Name, Suffix, Branch_ID, Branch_Name, Account_Status, Account_Relationship
FROM (
SELECT 
	DEP_FACT.GAM_ACID AS ACID
	,DEP_FACT.FORACID AS Account_Number
	,DEP_FACT.ACCT_NAME AS Account_Name
    ,DEP_FACT.GAM_SCHM_CODE AS Product_ID
    ,DEP_FACT.GAM_SCHM_TYPE AS Application
	,DEP_GAC.FREE_TEXT_5 AS Checkbook_Name1
	,DEP_GAC.FREE_TEXT_6 AS Checkbook_Name2
    ,DEP_FACT.CIF_ID AS CIF
	,CUST_DIM.CUST_FIRST_NAME AS First_Name
    ,CUST_DIM.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME AS Middle_Name
	,CUST_DIM.CUST_LAST_NAME AS Last_Name
    ,CUST_DIM.NAMESUFFIX AS Suffix
    ,DEP_FACT.SOL_ID AS Branch_ID
    ,DEP_SOL.SOL_DESC AS Branch_Name
    ,CASE WHEN DEP_FACT.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' AND DEP_FACT.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= DEP_FACT.AS_OF_DATE AND DEP_FACT.GAM_SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA') THEN 'C'
	    WHEN DEP_FACT.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N' AND DEP_FACT.GAM_SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA') THEN DEP_CASA.ACCT_STATUS
	    WHEN DEP_FACT.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' AND DEP_FACT.ACCT_CLS_DATE > DEP_FACT.AS_OF_DATE AND DEP_FACT.GAM_SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA') THEN DEP_CASA.ACCT_STATUS
	    END AS Account_Status
    ,CASE WHEN DEP_AAS.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'M' THEN 'Main Holder'
        WHEN DEP_AAS.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'J' THEN 'Joint Holder'
        WHEN DEP_AAS.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'A' THEN 'Authorized Signatory'
        WHEN DEP_AAS.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'G' THEN 'Guarantor'
        WHEN DEP_AAS.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'L' THEN 'Letter of Authority'
        ELSE 'Others'
        END AS Account_Relationship
FROM eds.DEPOSIT_FACT AS DEP_FACT
    INNER JOIN eds.EDS_CTL AS CTL
        ON DEP_FACT.AS_OF_DATE = CTL.DEPOSITS_DATE
        AND DEP_FACT.GAM_SCHM_TYPE = 'CAA'
        AND SUBSTRING(DEP_FACT.GAM_SCHM_CODE, 1, 2) <> '09'
        AND DEP_FACT.GAM_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
    INNER JOIN 
        (SELECT AS_OF_DATE, ACID, BANK_ID, ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE, CUST_ID, DEL_FLG, ENTITY_CRE_FLG FROM eds.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP WHERE ACID IN
            (SELECT ACID FROM eds.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP 
            WHERE AS_OF_DATE IN (SELECT DEPOSITS_DATE FROM eds.EDS_CTL)
            AND DEL_FLG <> 'Y'
            GROUP BY ACID HAVING COUNT(*) = 1)
        ) AS DEP_AAS
        ON DEP_AAS.CUST_ID = DEP_FACT.CUST_ID
        AND DEP_AAS.ACID = DEP_FACT.GAM_ACID
        AND DEP_AAS.BANK_ID = DEP_FACT.GAM_BANK_ID
        AND DEP_AAS.AS_OF_DATE = DEP_FACT.AS_OF_DATE
        AND DEP_AAS.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
    LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_GAC AS DEP_GAC
        ON DEP_FACT.GAM_ACID = DEP_GAC.ACID
        AND DEP_FACT.GAM_BANK_ID = DEP_GAC.BANK_ID
    --    AND DEP_GAC.FREE_TEXT_5 <> ''
        AND DEP_GAC.isActive = 1
        AND DEP_GAC.isLatest = 1
    LEFT JOIN eds.DEP_CASAMASTER AS DEP_CASA
        ON DEP_FACT.GAM_ACID = DEP_CASA.ACID
        AND DEP_FACT.GAM_BANK_ID = DEP_CASA.BANK_ID
        AND DEP_FACT.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN DEP_CASA.SCD_Start_Date AND DEP_CASA.SCD_End_Date
    LEFT JOIN eds.DEP_SERVICEOUTLETTABLE AS DEP_SOL
        ON DEP_FACT.SOL_ID = DEP_SOL.SOL_ID
        AND DEP_FACT.GAM_BANK_ID = DEP_SOL.BANK_ID
        AND DEP_FACT.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN DEP_SOL.SCD_Start_Date AND DEP_SOL.SCD_End_Date
    LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM AS CUST_DIM
	    ON DEP_FACT.CUST_ID = CUST_DIM.CORE_CUST_ID
        AND DEP_FACT.GAM_BANK_ID = CUST_DIM.BANK_ID
	    AND DEP_FACT.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CUST_DIM.SCD_Start_Date AND CUST_DIM.SCD_End_Date
    WHERE (DEP_FACT.ACCT_CLS_FLG <> 'Y' OR (DEP_FACT.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' AND DEP_FACT.ACCT_CLS_DATE > DEP_FACT.AS_OF_DATE)) AND DEP_FACT.GAM_SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA')
    ) A
    GROUP BY ACID, Account_Number, Account_Name, Product_ID, Application, Checkbook_Name1, Checkbook_Name2, CIF, First_Name, Middle_Name, Last_Name, Suffix, Branch_ID, Branch_Name, Account_Status, Account_Relationship;
GO
